narration:0:1810109001:0.text: The next instant, your consciousness slips away.
narration:0:1810109001:0.source_cn: 佐尔娅话音刚落，你的大脑便“嗡”的一声，失去了意识
narration:0:1810109001:0.male: The next instant, your consciousness slips away.
narration:0:1810109001:0.female: The next instant, your consciousness slips away.

narration:1:1810109002:0.text: When you open your eyes, you find yourself in a completely unfamiliar place...
narration:1:1810109002:0.source_cn: 当你睁开眼时，眼前的景象已经彻底改变……
